# MCP tool reference

::: v-pre

Every tool of the MCP server at `{prefix}/mcp`, as an agent sees it in `tools/list` (40 tools). How to connect, what arrives suggested and what agents never do: [AI Agents (MCP)](./agents-mcp.md). Each tool mirrors a REST route a person uses (*human twin*); case data comes back wrapped in `untrusted_data`.

| Group | Tools |
|---|---|
| Cases | [`list_cases`](#list-cases), [`get_case`](#get-case), [`create_case`](#create-case), [`update_case`](#update-case) |
| Brief and material | [`get_brief`](#get-brief), [`write_brief`](#write-brief), [`list_items`](#list-items), [`read_item`](#read-item), [`update_item`](#update-item), [`search_case`](#search-case) |
| Adding material | [`add_note`](#add-note), [`add_document`](#add-document), [`add_table`](#add-table), [`save_query`](#save-query), [`import_file`](#import-file), [`create_exploration`](#create-exploration), [`add_item`](#add-item) |
| Queries and tables | [`run_query`](#run-query), [`join_tables`](#join-tables), [`compare_tables`](#compare-tables), [`promote_tables`](#promote-tables) |
| Annotations and evidence | [`annotate`](#annotate), [`group`](#group), [`list_annotations`](#list-annotations), [`pin_evidence`](#pin-evidence) |
| Tasks | [`list_tasks`](#list-tasks), [`add_task`](#add-task), [`update_task`](#update-task) |
| Graph and entities | [`get_graph`](#get-graph), [`search_entities`](#search-entities), [`get_entity`](#get-entity), [`lookup_enrichment`](#lookup-enrichment), [`find_entity_cases`](#find-entity-cases) |

## Cases

### list_cases

A page of the cases you can read: ``items`` (id, title, status, case_type, fields, deadline, item and suggestion counts), ``total`` and ``counts``. Filters: status (open | analysis | closed, or several comma separated), case_type, external_ref, q (title or description), deadline (urgent | overdue), fields {id: "eq:x" | "gte:x" | "lte:x" | "contains:x"}; sort updated_at | created_at | title | deadline | field.&lt;id&gt;, "-" first for descending.

Human twin: `GET /api/investigations`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | string |  | null |
| `assignee` | string |  | null |
| `case_type` | string |  | null |
| `external_ref` | string |  | null |
| `q` | string |  | null |
| `deadline` | string |  | null |
| `fields` | object |  | null |
| `sort` | string |  | `"-updated_at"` |
| `limit` | integer |  | `50` |
| `offset` | integer |  | `0` |

### get_case

Case summary: status and stage, its case type (label, outcomes, actions, fields, stages, notice, playbook), its fields, tags, settings (vocabularies, agent_suggest_kinds), deadline, the decisions so far (outcome, targets, review, hash), the confirmed roles and the counts of items, suggestions and entities.

Human twin: `GET /api/investigations/{investigation_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |

### create_case

Open a new case owned by the person you act for. ``case_type`` is a slug from get_case_type (its required fields go in ``fields``); ``external_ref`` is the alert or ticket id: the same one again returns the case already opened for it (``created`` false), so a retry is safe.

Human twin: `POST /api/investigations`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `description` | string |  | null |
| `case_type` | string |  | `"general"` |
| `fields` | object |  | null |
| `external_ref` | string |  | null |
| `alert_at` | string |  | null |
| `occurred_at` | string |  | null |
| `tags` | list of string |  | null |

### update_case

Edit title, description, tags or fields (merged; a null removes one), the stage (one of the type's stages), or move the status (open ⇄ analysis). A status change by an agent is a suggestion when the case says so (default). The case type, the settings, assigning, deciding and closing are people's.

Human twin: `PATCH /api/investigations/{investigation_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `title` | string |  | null |
| `description` | string |  | null |
| `tags` | list of string |  | null |
| `status` | string |  | null |
| `fields` | object |  | null |
| `stage` | string |  | null |

## Brief and material

### get_brief

The case brief (markdown) and its item with versions.

Human twin: `GET /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/brief`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |

### write_brief

Write the case brief (markdown): a new version of the brief item, attributed to you. Cite item titles and hashes; never invent facts.

Human twin: `PUT /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/brief`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `text` | string | yes |  |

### list_items

The case material: items of kind graph | table | query | document | note with author, status (suggested | confirmed | rejected), latest version and pins. Read one with read_item.

Human twin: `GET /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/items`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `kind` | string |  | null |
| `status` | string |  | null |

### read_item

One item with its versions and the text of a version (latest by default): markdown, csv, json, extracted PDF/DOCX text; ``text`` is null when the format has none. Page with offset/limit (chars); ``text_length`` is the whole. An image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP: a screenshot, a scanned document, a chart) also comes back as image content you can look at, up to the org's size limit; other binaries never reach you.

Human twin: `GET /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/items/{item_id}`, `GET /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/items/{item_id}/versions`, `GET /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/items/{item_id}/text`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `item_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `version` | integer |  | null |
| `offset` | integer |  | `0` |
| `limit` | integer |  | `20000` |

### update_item

Edit an item's title, description or tags (content changes are new versions: add_item with item_id). ``chart`` shows a table as a chart: {"type": "line" | "bar", "x": column, "series": [columns]} (e.g. TPV and chargebacks by day); ``{}`` goes back to the table.

Human twin: `PATCH /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/items/{item_id}`

| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `item_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `title` | string |  | null |
| `description` | string |  | null |
| `tags` | list of string |  | null |
| `chart` | object |  | null |

### search_case

Items whose title, description, tags, query or text contain ``q`` (case-insensitive), with a snippet when the hit is in the text.

Human twin: `GET /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/search`

### import_file

Import a delimited or fixed-width text file as a table/csv item, with the text inline (up to about 4 MB; convert other formats to CSV first). ``mapping`` {as: "graph", spec} puts it on the canvas: spec is a file mapping {"version": 1, "inputs": {"t": {"match": "*.csv", "delimiter": ";" | "widths": [8, 10, …], "header": true}}, "nodes": [{"key", "type", "from": "t", "id": "t.col" | {"col", "normalize"}, "props"}], "edges": [{"from": "t", "type", "endpoints": {"self", "other"}, "props"}]}; the org's saved mappings are library docs of kind "mapping" (get_playbook lists and reads them; the body is the mapping JSON). {as: "enrichment", spec: {name, key_column, columns, match_node_types}} makes it a side table. Bigger files: POST the bytes to /api/investigations/{id}/items?kind=table &subkind=csv&filename=… with the same Bearer token, then update_item. Needs the investigation.upload permission of the person you act for.

Human twin: `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/items`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `filename` | string | yes |  |
| `text` | string | yes |  |
| `mapping` | object |  | null |
| `title` | string |  | null |
| `description` | string |  | null |

### create_exploration

Start a new exploration in a readable context and attach it to the case as a live reference; returns ``url`` for the person to open (``/graph/{context}?exploration=…&case=…``). ``graph_query`` (Cypher) seeds what it loads.

Human twin: `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/items`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `context_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `graph_query` | string |  | null |

### add_item

Generic add: any kind/subkind, or a new version of ``item_id`` (text or content_json). Kinds:

- graph: exploration_ref (exploration_id); snapshot/derived (content_json

{nodes: [{id, type, properties}], edges: [{id, source, target, type, properties}]}); selection (the same shape, every edge between listed nodes; "unified": true when the ids are the case's unified ids from get_graph); view (how the canvas looks, no data: {"filters": {"sources": [item ids], "roles": [], "tags": [], "groups": [group annotation ids], "types": [node types], "window": [start_ms, end_ms] | null}, "layout": "force" | "hierarchical" | …, "groups_closed": [group ids]}). A wrong shape is INVALID_CONTENT.

- table: csv text with mapping {as: graph | enrichment, spec}; result or

metrics as content_json {columns, rows}.

- query: query {text, language, parameters, output} + context_id.

- document: markdown text | link | upload; note: free | anchored on

anchor.entity_ids. ``provenance.tool/params`` stamps an analysis result. Prefer add_note, add_document, add_table, save_query, import_file when they fit.

Human twin: `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/items`, `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/items/{item_id}/versions`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `kind` | string | yes |  |
| `subkind` | string | yes |  |
| `title` | string |  | null |
| `text` | string |  | null |
| `content_json` | any |  | null |
| `description` | string |  | null |
| `tags` | list of string |  | null |
| `exploration_id` | uuid |  | null |
| `context_id` | uuid |  | null |
| `query` | object |  | null |
| `mapping` | object |  | null |
| `anchor` | object |  | null |
| `provenance` | object |  | null |
| `item_id` | uuid |  | null |

## Queries and tables

### run_query

Run a saved query item against its context; the result becomes a new version with ``run`` (statement id, duration, rows, parameters).

Human twin: `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/items/{item_id}/run`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `item_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `parameters` | object |  | null |
| `row_limit` | integer |  | `1000` |

### join_tables

Join two or more tables of the case by a key column (the first shared column when omitted) into a new table item whose provenance names its parents.

Human twin: `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/items/join`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `item_ids` | list of uuid | yes |  |
| `key_column` | string |  | null |
| `title` | string |  | null |

### compare_tables

Diff by key of two tables, or of two runs of one query (same item, two versions): rows only on one side, rows whose shared columns changed, how many are the same.

Human twin: `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/items/compare`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `left_item_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `right_item_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `left_version` | integer |  | null |
| `right_version` | integer |  | null |
| `key_column` | string |  | null |

### promote_tables

Promote tables (or the latest run of queries) to the graph (as_="graph": source_column, target_column, source_type, target_type, edge_type, normalize, amount_prop, time_prop) or to enrichment (as_="enrichment": key_column, match_node_types, match_source).

Human twin: `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/items/promote`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `item_ids` | list of uuid | yes |  |
| `as_` | string | yes |  |
| `options` | object |  | null |

## Annotations and evidence

### annotate

Annotate entities or items: role {"role"} on one entity (values from the case's settings.vocabularies.roles), tag {"tag"}, same_as on [keep, drop], hypothesis {"text", "status"?}, hypothesis_status {"status": open | supported | refuted} on a hypothesis id. Give the reason: the kinds in the case's agent_suggest_kinds arrive as suggestions a person confirms. Tasks: add_task; a decision: propose_decision.

Human twin: `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/annotations`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `kind` | string | yes |  |
| `targets` | list of string |  | null |
| `value` | object |  | null |
| `reason` | string |  | null |

### group

Groups of entities (05 §5). action="create" with name and entity_ids; "add" or "remove" entity_ids of group_id (or of the group named ``name``), a group an agent created (a person's group is theirs). Groups are a group annotation {name, color, by}.

Human twin: `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/annotations`, `PATCH /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/annotations/{annotation_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `action` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string |  | null |
| `entity_ids` | list of string |  | null |
| `group_id` | uuid |  | null |
| `color` | string |  | null |
| `reason` | string |  | null |

Annotations (role, tag, group, same_as, hypothesis, hypothesis_status, status_change, task, decision_proposal) with status, author and reason; ``target`` filters by entity or item id.

## Tasks

### list_tasks

Your work: tasks assigned to agents under this token's name (or to any agent) across the cases you read, oldest due first, each with its case. ``mine=False`` lists everyone's; ``investigation_id`` keeps one case; ``state`` open | done | cancelled (None for all); ``overdue`` only late ones. Pair it with changes_since to see what moved while you were away.

Human twin: `GET /api/investigations/tasks`, `GET /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/annotations`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid |  | null |
| `mine` | boolean |  | `true` |
| `state` | string |  | `"open"` |
| `overdue` | boolean |  | null |

### add_task

A follow-up on the case: for a person (``assignee`` e-mail) or an agent (``assignee_kind="agent"``, ``agent_name`` = the token name that should pick it up; empty = any agent). ``due_at`` ISO datetime; ``targets`` the entities it is about. It arrives as a suggestion a person confirms.

Human twin: `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/annotations`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `assignee` | string |  | null |
| `assignee_kind` | string |  | `"human"` |
| `agent_name` | string |  | null |
| `due_at` | string |  | null |
| `targets` | list of string |  | null |
| `reason` | string |  | null |

### update_task

Move a task you wrote or that is assigned to you (agent): ``state`` done | cancelled | open, a new ``title`` or ``due_at``; ``note`` says what was done (kept as the task's reason). Works on a closed case too.

Human twin: `PATCH /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/annotations/{annotation_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `task_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `state` | string |  | null |
| `title` | string |  | null |
| `due_at` | string |  | null |
| `note` | string |  | null |

## Analyses

### run_analysis

The analyses of the workspace on the unified graph. kind: "trace" (follow the money: seed_edge_ids | seed_node, direction forward|backward, allocation fifo|proportional|libr|total|lifo, max_hops, max_dwell_hours, min_amount, window, stop_types, stop_nodes; returns exits, coverage and ``method``, cite it); "paths" (source, target, mode shortest|weighted|k-shortest|earliest, directed, weight, k, t0, max_dwell_hours); "er" (entity resolution: block_on [email, phone, document, …] and name_keys [name, …]; new pairs become suggested same_as); "links" (attributes [phone, email, device_id, …], min_shared, entity_types, normalize {attr: phone|email|digits|…}: shares_&lt;attr&gt; edges between entities sharing them); "communities" (label propagation; min_size). ``save=true`` keeps the result as an item (table/result, or graph/derived for links) stamped with provenance {tool, params}.

Human twin: `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/analysis/trace`, `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/analysis/paths`, `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/analysis/er`, `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/events`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `kind` | string | yes |  |
| `params` | object |  | null |
| `save` | boolean |  | `false` |
| `title` | string |  | null |

## Reports and decisions

### render_report

Draft a report from an org template (a memo, a regulator narrative, a letter): the case's values fill its {{placeholders}} and the result is a markdown document a person approves (it arrives suggested). Without ``template``, lists the templates (the case type's first).

Human twin: `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/reports`, `GET /api/org/library`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `template` | string |  | null |
| `title` | string |  | null |

### propose_decision

Propose the decision; a person records it (you never decide). ``outcome`` is one of the case type's outcomes (get_case shows the catalog) or, for a type without one, ``outcome_label`` + ``closes_case``. ``targets``: the entities it is about; ``tasks``: [{"action": &lt;the type's action id&gt;} or {"title": …, "assignee_kind": "agent", "agent_name": …}]; ``evidence``: [{"item_id", "version"}] of pinned versions (pin_evidence first). The rationale cites the evidence (E1, E2…). The person sees the decision panel filled in and records it, edits it or rejects it.

Human twin: `POST /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/annotations`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `rationale` | string | yes |  |
| `outcome` | string |  | null |
| `outcome_label` | string |  | null |
| `closes_case` | boolean |  | null |
| `targets` | list of string |  | null |
| `tasks` | list of object |  | null |
| `evidence` | list of object |  | null |

## Journal

### list_events

The case journal, oldest first; ``after`` is the last event id you saw.

Human twin: `GET /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/events`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `after` | uuid |  | null |
| `limit` | integer |  | `100` |

### changes_since

What changed since an ISO 8601 timestamp (everything when omitted): journal events, items created or with a new version, annotations. Returns ``now`` to pass next time.

Human twin: `GET /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/events`, `GET /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/items`, `GET /api/investigations/{investigation_id}/annotations`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `investigation_id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `since` | string |  | null |

## Organization

### get_case_type

The org's case types (slug, label, description) when ``slug`` is omitted; one type in full otherwise: vocabularies (roles, tags, link_attributes), outcomes and actions of its decisions, its fields (what create_case needs), stages, SLA hours, notice and playbook. Use its vocabulary before inventing a role or tag.

Human twin: `GET /api/org/case-types`, `GET /api/org/case-types/{slug}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | string |  | null |

### get_playbook

A doc of the org library by slug — a playbook (markdown steps), a report template (render_report uses it) or a saved file mapping (JSON) — or the list of slugs, titles and kinds when omitted. Start with "claude_code_quickstart". Playbooks are also org://playbooks/{slug}.

Human twin: `GET /api/org/library`, `GET /api/org/library/{slug}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | string |  | null |

## Resources

| URI template | Content |
|---|---|
| `case://{investigation_id}/brief` | The case brief as markdown. |
| `case://{investigation_id}/items` | The case material (items with versions and pins). |
| `case://{investigation_id}/items/{item_id}` | The text of an item's latest version (markdown, csv, json, extracted PDF/DOCX); never its bytes. |
| `case://{investigation_id}/graph{?offset,limit}` | The unified case graph, nodes paged by offset/limit (default 500). |
| `case://{investigation_id}/changes{?since}` | Events, items and annotations since an ISO timestamp. |
| `org://playbooks/{slug}` | A playbook of the org library (markdown); {investigation_id} is a placeholder. |
| `org://case-types/{slug}` | A case type of the org: vocabularies, decisions, actions, fields, SLA, notice. |

## Prompts

One prompt per playbook of the org library (built in: `claude_code_quickstart`, `triage`, `assemble_brief`; the org's own appear too), with `investigation_id` as argument, plus `playbook(slug, investigation_id)` for any library doc. Claude Code shows them as slash commands (`/mcp__graphlagoon__triage <case id>`).

:::
